req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the Location header must be set correctly when a new player is created. This is crucial for RESTful APIs to provide clients with the URI of the newly created resource. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle existing squad numbers, and a boundary test to ensure the system handles edge cases correctly.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The player with squad number 27 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with valid player data.
expected: The Location header is set to /players/squadnumber/27.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 27,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/players/squadnumber/27'

tests.name: test_create_player_conflict
preconditions: The player with squad number 10 already exists in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a squad number that already exists.
expected: The response contains a conflict error message.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Duplicate",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Midfielder",
    "abbrPosition": "MF",
    "team": "Test Team",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()['detail']
